ADDED i1: Tests for {@link SimpleBloomFilter#estimateIntersection(BloomFilter)}. The test shape uses k=17 hash functions and m=72 bits, which gives well-defined estimatio
ADDED i2: Shape shared across all test scenarios: 17 hash functions, 72 bits.
ADDED i4: A filter populated by a single hasher starting at index 1.
ADDED i5: A filter populated by two hashers (starting at 1 and at 11), representing two elements.
ADDED i6: A filter with every bit set — represents an "infinite" or fully-saturated population.
ADDED i7: --- Overlapping filters --- FROM1 is contained in the two-element filter, so the intersection estimates 1 element.
ADDED i8: FROM1 is also contained in the full filter, so the estimate remains 1.
ADDED i9: Symmetric check: two-element ∩ single-element still estimates 1.
ADDED i10: The full filter contains all two-element bits, so the intersection estimate equals 2.
ADDED i12: --- Disjoint filters (no shared bits) --- When two filters share no bits, the inclusion-exclusion estimate goes negative, so estimateIntersection must throw Ill
